MS/MS analysis was performed in a data-dependent multinotch mode
CID spectra of the most intense precursor ions were recorded in the ion trap... MS3 spectra for reporter ion quantitation were recorded at 50 000 resolution with HCD fragmentation
collision energy setting of 30 for 3 s (‘top speed’ setting)... HCD fragmentation at collision energy of and 55
fragment mass tolerance to 0.6 Da
The precursor mass tolerance was set to 5 ppm
